'''Kyle Odoon''' was an heir to the [[Mor]] of the [[Odoon clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. He was one of many suitors who sought the affections of [[Ido Glayyd]]. To Ido, Odoon stood out from the suitors from the other clans as being more interested in her than the [[House Glayyd]]'s estate, as well as more pleasant to be around.
